summary: Provider-independent supervision of an external research agent (first: Autoscience Mira) for internal admission testing under OWNER-CHALLENGE-ADMISSION-01 as amended; internal development only, never mainnet, not a qualification gate. A durable campaign controller persists intent and reserves worst-case spend before dispatch, reconciles ambiguous dispatch instead of retrying, enforces owner-supplied grant and per-campaign ceilings and limits outside the agent, halts on unknown state or usage, verifies cancellation, records findings that stop expansion, and keeps a hash-chained attempt ledger; tested against a fake provider with crash recovery and mutation checks. Separate roles, workspaces and credentials with an allowlisted research checkout and canaries. A versioned design-search commitment layer serves a separate development experiment and refuses EV4 material. The Mira adapter refuses every call because its integration contract is unverified (capability report and owner inquiry), so live Mira execution is BLOCKED; the Level-0 study sheet is prepared, not frozen or executed; no campaign has run and no evidence is accepted.
